Name: Little And Tiny TVs
Author: Mushroomed
Description:
[center][font=Verdana][color=#f4f4f4][size=5][b]Little & Tiny TVs[/b][/size][/color][/font]﻿
[size=2][font=Arial]Requires [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458][b][font=Arial][color=#ea9999][i]Furniture Framework![/i][/color][/font][/b][/url]
[/size][/center][size=2]


[font=Arial]Came to be from an idea to see how small I possibly could make a TV, for it to still work and the channel animation to be still visible. Just two little TVs, one variation of both. They can be placed on a one tile slot, for example on a table, but you can only interact with them when they are placed down on the floor. Both appear in the furniture catalogue.

When I was making these it took much longer that I can admit to adjust the screen overlay positioning to look right. I think it looks okay, considering the scale, but let me know if it's still not quite there! I might try to improve it if I can.

Inspired by all the smallest, comfy farmhouse map replacements, where every tile counts. [color=#f4f4f4]♡
[/color]The retexture of the channels shown on the image is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387][b][color=#ea9999][i]Kitty Channels![/i][/color][/b][/url]
[/font]
